# R2 evals — Shell: five-place side rail, sub-tabs, ask bar, laptop gate

> Base for every diff check in this file is commit `230e1c1` (end of R1), not origin/main. CommandPalette lives at `src/components/palette/CommandPalette.tsx`.

Run all commands from the worktree root (`.claude/worktrees/flat-redesign`). Source of truth: `docs/build/redesign-spec.md`, "Rules" and "R2 Shell". A check is PASS only if the stated expectation holds; any other result is FAIL. Checks were written from the spec, not from the builder's code.

## Preamble (paste once per shell)

`RF <path>...` prints `railFor(path)?.id` (or `undefined`) for each path, one per line, by importing `src/lib/ia.ts` directly with Node type stripping. `RAILJ` prints `RAIL` as JSON. If the import fails only because `ia.ts` uses a `@/` alias, FAIL R2-01..R2-05 and report it (the registry must stay importable; the named vitest titles in section I still run).

```sh
RF() { node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings -e 'import("./src/lib/ia.ts").then(m=>{for(const p of process.argv.slice(1)){const r=m.railFor(p);console.log(r?r.id:"undefined")}})' -- "$@"; }
RAILJ() { node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings -e 'import("./src/lib/ia.ts").then(m=>console.log(JSON.stringify(m.RAIL)))'; }
```
